#*Golf Cart Rentals Delivered to You*

##Rentals for events, weddings, commerical use, and much more.##

**3 day minimum for all rental deliveries**


##About

- All our vehicles are lithium powered & have a range of 20-30 miles
- 110V outlet required for charging vehicle overnight
- 4 passenger: 2 seats facing forward and 2 seats facing backward 
- Carts are street legal and must stay on street roads at all times unless on private property.
- All carts go up to 25 mph

Please note: No children under 2 years of age are allowed on golf carts.

## Requirements

- All drivers must have a valid drivers license
- Rental contract must be signed prior to delivery 
- 50% deposit taken at time of booking
